verdict.rationale: There is no opt-out switch, but the docs say the bundled helper scripts are all standard-library Python and 'none touch the network', which implies no telemetry from them. The skills are plain SKILL.md files and local folders that write to a project 'replica/' directory, so this privacy posture is implied rather than stated. missing for 10: an explicit no-telemetry/no-tracking statement covering the whole skill pack, a documented opt-out mechanism if any tracking exists, and independent verification.
